1.consolidated_definition: educ. Estudios universitarios de dos años. Carrera universitaria corta. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. El Departamento de Administración de Empresas de la Universidad Central de Bayamón tiene una amplia gama de ofertas a nivel de bachillerato y de grado asociado (Primera Hora, 11-10-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Associate's degree. Brief university career. Adapted Anglicism, commonly used. The Department of Business Administration at the Central University of Bayamón offers a wide range of programs at the associate and bachelor's levels (First Hour, 11-10-05)
